# ZAP add-ons the scan loads besides those in its image, as "<url> <sha-256>". The image has only the
# release passive rules. The beta ones check the Permissions-Policy, cross-origin and caching headers,
# and ZAP's own baseline scan fetches them as it starts. Pinned here instead so a new release can't
# change what fails the build. To update, take the url and hash from ZAP's list of add-ons for the
# image's version (https://github.com/zaproxy/zap-admin, ZapVersions-<version>.xml).
